# Sectioned Edit

## Summary
The grouped-edit scaffold: the root is the scroller and the `edit` container, the shared **Edit Section Nav** sits sticky on the left, and each yielded `Section` carries its own `data-sect` anchor, focused halo and a 1–4 column field grid. Consumers decide only the grouping.

## Usage
```gts
import { SectionedEdit } from '@cardstack/catalog/components/sectioned-edit';

<SectionedEdit @sections={{this.sections}} as |e|>
  <e.Section @id='identity' @title='Identity' @cols={{3}}>
    <FieldContainer @label='Title' @vertical={{true}}><@fields.title /></FieldContainer>
  </e.Section>
</SectionedEdit>
```
Certification Authority's edit form is built on it; open `CertificationAuthority/northwind-academy` in edit to see the sections and the rail.

## Non-goals
Does not decide grouping, validation or save behaviour; does not replace Edit Section Nav (it consumes it).
